prompt: Create a precise sparse Chinese heritage ink LINE DRAWING of the Song Pingjiang city map stone stele kept at Suzhou Confucian Temple: tall rectangular dark stone map slab, top with stylized pair of carved dragons, lower large engraved abstract city plan of waterways and street grid. Image 1 is the subject photo and image 2 is the project's line plate style reference. Follow the actual photo's identifying silhouette, composition and present condition. Remove glass cases, glare, signs, flowers, people, floors and modern backgrounds. Center the complete object with ample margin. Only clean fine charcoal-black contour lines and a few sparse material or relief marks. Represent any inscriptions or maps with abstract nonlegible marks; do not invent Chinese characters or text. Every blank canvas pixel must be flat opaque #FFFFFF. No gray background, gradients, shadows, paper grain, watercolor, colored ink, filled black masses, checkerboard or transparent canvas. 3:4 portrait composition.
